message: ４８キロだから微妙

name: Nanaka
message: 「How is it, think you can manage, Synn? Maybe I should carry half after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine. I might be a little smaller than average, but something like this is--heave... ho!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, you actually hoisted them up. Not bad, Synn.」
I hoist two heavy burlap sacks stuffed with adzuki beans onto both shoulders and hold them steady.
After school, Nanaka invited me to start some solo training for the Crusaders.
...However, the place I arrived at after following her directions was the ever-familiar Yuugiri-an.

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, it's definitely a workout, sure, but sneaking in help for the shop? That's so like you, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It builds up your body too, so it's two birds with one stone!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though, this isn't for the shop--it's a duty of the Yuugiri family.」

name: Synn
message: 「...? Bringing adzuki beans to Asukai Shrine?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet! Every year when autumn rolls around, we make an offering.」

name: Synn
message: 「I had no idea...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's no big deal anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, maybe I'll ask about that on the way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Before that, Nanaka, open the door.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Comin' right up!」
Since both my hands are full, Nanaka briskly slides open the entrance to Yuugiri-an for me.
Through Shiokumi Shopping District and into Tsukinoo Park. Follow the wharf east, and there stands the first torii gate of Asukai Shrine.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mufufu~」
All along the way as we carry the bags of adzuki beans, Nanaka keeps grinning happily.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look at you, Synn, getting all built without me noticing. Just one of those bags is a bit over twenty kilos, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「To be honest, arm strength has nothing to do with it? I'm just resting them on my shoulders like straw bales.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, you sure surprised me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If two of 'em weigh over forty kilos, that means...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mufufu~. If he really felt like it, Synn could scoop me up in a kidnapper carry--」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Doryaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!」
Kim-san marches off toward the shopping district with three commercial bags of flour hoisted on his back.
Thirty kilos a bag. Roughly a hundred kilos in total.

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, sorry, Nanaka, I didn't catch that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I said, why don't you carry me too--」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「ZUORYAAAAAHHH!!」
The auntie from Shinagawa walks toward the shopping district with two pickling barrels crammed full of takuan tucked under each arm.
It easily has to be over two hundred kilos.

name: Synn
message: 「What was that, Nanaka? Speak up a little.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I want you to carry me in your arms too--」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Feed me beef bowls.」
Eauderourke walks toward the beef bowl shop carrying over a dozen cows in his arms.
The total weight easily has to be over five tons.

name: Synn
message: 「...Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha... It's nothing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, Synn! Start climbing the shrine path, I'll support your back from behind.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm counting on you.」

name: Shio
message: 「Thank you for your continued patronage. May your visit be blessed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no, thank you. Shio-chan, take care of this for me.」
After offering up a massive amount of adzuki beans, we meet up with Shio-chan.
Nanaka pulls a worn-out charm from her pocket and hands it to Shio-chan.

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm... Shall I bring you the same one as before?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You betcha.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka? Are you getting a defective charm exchanged?」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How rude! There are no counterfeits among the wares of Asukai!」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono. Once a year has passed since receiving a talisman, it is custom to return it and seek a new one, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, really? I always thought they were disposable.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You're gonna get struck by divine punishment, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「Admonishing Synn-dono aside... are you truly sure you wish to acquire the exact same thing as this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, I'm a maiden too, you know. A good-luck charm for love is basic stuff for a girl!」

name: Shio
message: 「L-Nanaka-dono, what you have been carrying is a talisman for safe childbirth, is it not?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No wonder I haven't made any progress this past year... guh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, don't they say giving birth is easier than worrying about it?」

name: Synn
message: 「You won the election, Nanaka, and KiraFes was a huge success. The charm's divine blessing definitely helped.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh! Splendid follow-up. I shall take notes from that for future reference!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just gotta point this out, that's a bit different from what 'safe childbirth' means, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kyau!? T-The psychic damage is way too massive, I can't put any strength into my legs...」

name: Synn
message: 「Careful now... I'll give you a piggyback ride home.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「J-Just lending me your shoulder is plenty, okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it, let's do that then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha, so it wasn't the charm's fault, it was mine...」

name: Synn
message: 「Quit grumbling and come on, let's go!」
Lending Nanaka my shoulder, I slowly walk down the shrine approach stairs one step at a time.
Although it took about three times longer than usual to reach the bottom, for some reason it felt nostalgic.
I wonder why?
